scope: Throwaway prototype route only; do not change the production UNIT theme.
signatureInteraction: UNIT plates separate, an opaque aged-paper bridge covers the layout swap, then the same sheet contracts into the Desk newspaper's folded opening pose.
opening: Native scroll unfolds the paper, settles its crease, resolves ink, and commits one masthead stamp.

chapterEvents.columns: article pile dealt while diary cover opens
chapterEvents.classified: torn notice pull, tape pressure, VACANT stamp
chapterEvents.about: owner book opens and interest slips land
chapterEvents.index: ruled notebook opens and labels settle
chapterEvents.outro: edition folds into mail slot and flap rebounds

mobile: Keep native vertical scroll, contained horizontal strips, smaller fold pose, and all transition decoration away from readable content.
reducedMotion: Skip the transition atomically, remove opening distance, show the settled Desk layout, and cancel pending frames and timers on live preference changes.
forbidden: No generic whole-section fade as the primary event
